product.title: Private Guided Hiking Tour in Yosemite

description.text: Book a private guided hike with a Yosemite expert who builds a route around your fitness level and goals. Options range from valley waterfall walks to longer treks with views of Half Dome, Glacier Point, or Tuolumne Grove depending on season.

highlights: Route customized to fitness and interests
Seasonal routing to Glacier Point or groves
Extended time on trail away from crowds

start.description: Meet your private guide at the agreed Yosemite trailhead or valley meeting point.

end.description: Return to the meeting point after your private hike.

itineraryItems.title: Yosemite Valley
itineraryItems.description: Private hike through valley trails with guide-selected routing.

itineraryItems.title: Glacier Point
itineraryItems.description: Seasonal ascent to Glacier Point when road access permits.

itineraryItems.title: Tuolumne Grove
itineraryItems.description: Optional grove walk among giant sequoias when included in your route.
